intro.text: Ornament is a Cryptic bonded to Beryl, one of Shallan's Lightweavers.

items.text: Ornament bonded Beryl, usually riding inside her shirt in the Physical Realm because she did not like to be seen. With other Cryptics, she liked to watch Shallan draw.
Ornament went with Beryl on the journey to Lasting Integrity. When Shallan suspected Beryl of spying for the Ghostbloods, she questioned Ornament, but got nothing useful from her.

appearance.text: Ornament has a delicate, lacelike head pattern and a squeaky voice. She glides smoothly like most Cryptics, unlike Pattern's bouncy movement.

personality.text: Ornament is shy of being seen, but makes excited noises and bounces while watching Shallan draw. Like other Cryptics, she takes human speech literally and has a limited Alethi vocabulary.
